definition: A crossing formula that keeps the flood image explicit on the release side.
notes: Use this record when the text explicitly asks or says that someone crossed over the flood. The phrase inherits the house distinction between ogha as flood and tarati as crossing language. Do not flatten it into generic liberation or escape prose.

context_rules.context: In direct translation of the flood-crossing formula

context_rules.notes: Use this as a controlled alternate when the image remains explicit.

translation_policy.default_scope: Use this as the standard wording when a text says or asks that someone has crossed over the flood, keeping both the ogha image and the crossing verb explicit.
translation_policy.when_not_to_apply: Do not use this phrasing where ogha is being defined or enumerated rather than crossed, and do not substitute generic escape or liberation prose for the crossing image.
translation_policy.drift_risk: Prevents the flood-crossing image from being flattened into unmarked liberation-language, which would also blur ogha against the repository's governed escape and release families.
